_note: Which model does which kind of work (D51, owner 2026-10-25: a roster of small or MoE specialists, each best at one task kind; the online provider only reasons over what a specialist produced). kind -> llama-swap alias (jarvis/local_models/llama-swap.yaml), a fallback alias tried when the first errors, the answer budget, and what it is for. Loaded by jarvis/plugins/_shared/specialists.py: a missing file means the built-in copy of this table; an unknown kind or a badly written alias is a clear error; an alias the llama-swap file does not define yet is reported as 'not installed yet', never a failure.

reason.note: the online provider through the privacy gateway: understands the goal, writes the plan, reasons over a specialist's redacted summary. Never forms a tool call, never sees a screenshot.

ui_decide.note: picks the exact PC step (tool, app, key, target) for a plan step; grammar-forced JSON (plugins/desktop/decide.py).

screen_read.note: what is on the screen: the accessibility tree first, then OCR, then this vision alias only for what has no text (node/jarvis_node/vision.py).

screen_locate.note: where a label is in a window (UI-Venus grounding); a point from it is checked before use.

doc_read.note: scanned pages and pictures of pages to text (plugins/doc_reader).

chat_simple.note: short, simple local work: choosing the arguments of a read-only step. local-chat is the Ling MoE once installed; general is the Ling MoE today.

translate.note: D58: the LLM translator for romanized Telugu/Hindi (Tenglish, Hinglish) and the fallback for script text; Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507 (the decider model, already installed). Telugu/Hindi script text goes first to the in-process IndicTrans2 200M (language.text_backends). Runs on this PC only: never an online provider.

language._note: D58 language layer (jarvis/plugins/_shared/translate.py). Every model sees English only; the owner's own words are kept in D:\jarvis\data\translate\translations.jsonl. All backends are LOCAL (in-process, or a llama-swap alias on 127.0.0.1): nothing is translated online. reply_language: en (default) | match | te | hi; the owner changes it by saying 'reply in Telugu'. tts_verified stays false until a Telugu or Hindi voice has been installed and heard by the owner.
